description: B+ Tree leaf split promotes the maximum key of the right sibling instead of the minimum key, breaking internal router search navigation.
spec_notes: LeafNode.split must promote right_leaf.keys[0] as the separator key.

"""B+ Tree leaf node with sequential sibling pointer."""

from typing import Any, List, Optional, Tuple
from bplus_node import BPlusNode


class LeafNode(BPlusNode):
    def __init__(self, max_keys: int = 3):
        super().__init__(is_leaf=True)
        self.max_keys = max_keys
        self.values: List[Any] = []
        self.next_leaf: Optional["LeafNode"] = None

    def insert(self, key: int, value: Any) -> Optional[Tuple[int, "LeafNode"]]:
        # Insert in sorted order
        idx = 0
        while idx < len(self.keys) and self.keys[idx] < key:
            idx += 1
        if idx < len(self.keys) and self.keys[idx] == key:
            self.values[idx] = value
            return None
        self.keys.insert(idx, key)
        self.values.insert(idx, value)

        if len(self.keys) > self.max_keys:
            return self.split()
        return None

    def split(self) -> Tuple[int, "LeafNode"]:
        mid = len(self.keys) // 2
        right_leaf = LeafNode(self.max_keys)
        right_leaf.keys = self.keys[mid:]
        right_leaf.values = self.values[mid:]
        self.keys = self.keys[:mid]
        self.values = self.values[:mid]
        right_leaf.next_leaf = self.next_leaf
        self.next_leaf = right_leaf
        # BUG: Promotes last key of right leaf instead of first key (min) of right leaf!
        promoted_key = right_leaf.keys[-1]
        return promoted_key, right_leaf

from bplus_tree import BPlusTree


def test_leaf_insert_and_search():
    t = BPlusTree(max_keys=3)
    t.insert(10, "val_10")
    t.insert(20, "val_20")
    assert t.search(10) == "val_10"
    assert t.search(20) == "val_20"
    assert t.search(30) is None


def test_split_promotes_correct_separator_key():
    t = BPlusTree(max_keys=3)
    # Insert 4 keys to force split on leaf with max_keys=3
    for k in [10, 20, 30, 40]:
        t.insert(k, f"v_{k}")

    # All 4 keys must be searchable across root routing
    assert t.search(10) == "v_10"
    assert t.search(20) == "v_20"
    assert t.search(30) == "v_30"
    assert t.search(40) == "v_40"


def test_range_query_spans_leaf_chain():
    t = BPlusTree(max_keys=3)
    for k in [5, 15, 25, 35, 45, 55]:
        t.insert(k, f"val_{k}")
    res = t.range_query(15, 45)
    assert res == ["val_15", "val_25", "val_35", "val_45"]


def test_sequential_insert_large():
    t = BPlusTree(max_keys=3)
    for i in range(1, 15):
        t.insert(i, f"item_{i}")
    for i in range(1, 15):
        assert t.search(i) == f"item_{i}"

"""B+ Tree leaf node with sequential sibling pointer."""

from typing import Any, List, Optional, Tuple
from bplus_node import BPlusNode


class LeafNode(BPlusNode):
    def __init__(self, max_keys: int = 3):
        super().__init__(is_leaf=True)
        self.max_keys = max_keys
        self.values: List[Any] = []
        self.next_leaf: Optional["LeafNode"] = None

    def insert(self, key: int, value: Any) -> Optional[Tuple[int, "LeafNode"]]:
        idx = 0
        while idx < len(self.keys) and self.keys[idx] < key:
            idx += 1
        if idx < len(self.keys) and self.keys[idx] == key:
            self.values[idx] = value
            return None
        self.keys.insert(idx, key)
        self.values.insert(idx, value)

        if len(self.keys) > self.max_keys:
            return self.split()
        return None

    def split(self) -> Tuple[int, "LeafNode"]:
        mid = len(self.keys) // 2
        right_leaf = LeafNode(self.max_keys)
        right_leaf.keys = self.keys[mid:]
        right_leaf.values = self.values[mid:]
        self.keys = self.keys[:mid]
        self.values = self.values[:mid]
        right_leaf.next_leaf = self.next_leaf
        self.next_leaf = right_leaf
        # Promoted key is first key of the new right sibling
        promoted_key = right_leaf.keys[0]
        return promoted_key, right_leaf
